'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**Seven [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] [[militant]]s are killed in [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]], by two [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]] [[drone strike]]s. [https://france24.com/en/live-news/20230824-turkish-drones-kill-7-pkk-members-as-fm-meets-iraq-kurds (AFP via France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Air traffic controllers]] at [[Beirut]]’s [[Rafik Hariri International Airport]] in [[Lebanon]] announce they will go on [[Strike action|strike]] next month due to severe staffing shortages, partially closing the airport. [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-airport-strike-air-traffic-beirut-11e6575aaf8f50e109c90f9899594bfc (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed and seven are rescued in a boat crash in [[Lafia]], [[Nasarawa State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://punchng.com/nasarawa-assembly-mourns-as-boat-crash-claims-12-lives-in-lafia/ (Punch)]
*One person is killed and eight others are injured by [[rockfall]]s in the [[Ein Gedi Nature Reserve|Ein Gedi]] [[nature reserve]] in [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/five-year-old-boy-killed-eight-hurt-in-rockslide-near-the-dead-sea/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Discharge of radioactive water of the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant|Discharge of radioactive water of the Fukushima Nuclear Plant]]
**[[Japan]] begins the discharge of [[Wastewater treatment|treated]] [[radioactive waste]] water from the [[Fukushima nuclear disaster|damaged]] [[Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant]] into the [[Pacific Ocean]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/japan/fukushima-nuclear-water-release-japan-b2398450.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[15th BRICS summit]]
**[[South African President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] invites [[Argentina]], [[Egypt]], [[Ethiopia]], [[Iran]], [[Saudi Arabia]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]] to join [[BRICS|the bloc]], with membership taking effect next year. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-08-24/brics-summit-2023-south-africa-bloc-invites-saudi-iran-four-others-as-members#xj4y7vzkg (Bloomberg)]
*[[China–Japan relations]]
**[[China]] suspends the import of [[Agriculture,_forestry,_and_fishing_in_Japan#Fisheries|Japanese seafood]] following Japan's discharge of treated radioactive waste water from [[Fukushima (city)|Fukushima]]. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/china-halts-japanese-seafood-imports-selfish-fukushima-release.1051069 (AFP via ''The Times of Malta'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**The [[Maui County, Hawaii|County of Maui]] in [[Hawaii]], [[United States]], files a lawsuit against [[Hawaiian Electric Industries|Hawaiian Electric]], alleging negligence and failing to shut down equipment during the [[wildfire|wildfires]] that ravaged [[Maui|the island]] including [[Lahaina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/shareholders-sue-hawaiian-electric-over-maui-wildfires-2023-08-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Adass Israel School sex abuse scandal]]
**The [[County Court of Victoria]] in [[Australia]] sentences Malka Leifer, the principal of a Jewish [[religious school]] in [[Melbourne]], to 15 years in prison for the [[sexual assault]] of two sisters. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2635139 (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]
*[[Georgia election racketeering prosecution]]
**Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] is booked at [[Fulton County Jail|a jail]] in [[Fulton County, Georgia|Fulton County]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/live-blog/trump-arraignment-georgia-indictment-live-updates-rcna100652 (NBC News)]
*[[Colombia]] introduces [[Colombian passport|passports]] with a [[Non-binary gender|non-binary]] option, following a 2022 [[Judiciary of Colombia|court]] ruling that permitted such identification on official documents. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1821705/colombia-adds-non-binary-gender-option-on-passports (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*A [[Germany|German]] [[Federal Court of Justice|federal court]] rejects an appeal by a [[Bundeswehr|military officer]] who posed as a asylum-seeker and was convicted of plotting to attack prominent politicians. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-far-right-soldier-plot-appeal-rejected-fc9b9422ddc080a773288e7e7dc1fb09 (AP)]
*The [[U.S.]] [[United States Department of Justice|Department of Justice]] sues [[SpaceX]] for alleged hiring discrimination against [[refugees]] and people seeking or granted [[Right of asylum|asylum]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spacex-discrimination-hiring-elon-musk-ea710b331f30754526e10e7ac836e087 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Chess World Cup 2023]]
**[[Norway]]'s [[Magnus Carlsen]] wins his first [[Chess World Cup]] title after defeating [[Chess in India|India]]'s [[R Praggnanandhaa]] in a [[Tiebreaker|tiebreak]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/08/24/sport/magnus-carlsen-chess-world-cup-rameshbabu-praggnanandhaa-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
